leptonica commit 6edccb242f5b80ffd277fcfc6f966ddf97972ef6 (Fri Nov 6 13:58:59 2026 -0800)

Static Windows x64 build (MinGW-w64), no installer, no DLLs beyond Windows system DLLs.
Reads PBM/BMP input. Used by the PDF Optimizer notebooks in lossless generic-region mode only (jbig2 -p),
so no symbol substitution ("6 becomes 8") can occur.
Place jbig2.exe in the same folder as the notebooks.
